stories.title: Trump's AI task force met Thursday, discussed AI-powered cyberattacks
stories.simple_summary: Government officials met to talk about how bad actors could use AI to attack computer systems and steal information. They want to figure out ways to protect against these attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect your daily life right now, but it shows the government is thinking about AI safety. There's nothing you need to do today.

stories.title: Union County moms say daughters are victims of AI child porn created by classmates
stories.simple_summary: Some parents say their daughters were victimized when classmates used AI to create fake inappropriate images of them. This is a serious crime that involves fake pictures made by computer.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren or know young people, this is a real danger. Talk to them about not sharing photos with classmates and about reporting this kind of thing to adults immediately.

stories.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
stories.simple_summary: Congress is investigating Nvidia, a big computer chip company, because of questions about its business deals and whether there are political favors involved. This is the second investigation into the same company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own Nvidia stock. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nonprofits sue Anthropic, Google, and other tech giants to freeze the AI arms race
stories.simple_summary: Some nonprofit groups are suing big tech companies because they want them to stop racing to build bigger and more powerful AI systems. They're asking courts to freeze these companies' AI development.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you right now, but these lawsuits could slow down how fast AI changes things. The outcome could matter more in a few years.

stories.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
stories.simple_summary: An AI system called Muse can now make phone calls to businesses for you, but you have to pay to use this service. It's not free like some other AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business, you need to know that AI systems might start calling you. If you get strange calls from an AI, you can ask the caller to identify themselves.

stories.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
stories.simple_summary: Google made a new AI assistant that's better at understanding questions that have multiple parts or are confusing. It can now break down complicated questions and answer each part separately.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google to search for things, your search results might get a little better when you ask complicated questions. This is a small improvement.

stories.title: Wall Street Whistles Past Nvidia Risk to Bet on Wobbly AI Trade
stories.simple_summary: Wall Street investors are ignoring potential risks about Nvidia's future and continuing to buy the company's stock. Experts worry they may be making a risky bet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors who own stocks. There's nothing you need to do unless you have money in the stock market.

stories.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.simple_summary: The head of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, stepped down from his job after personal scandals came to light. Some people worry this could affect America's competition with China in building advanced computer systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is big company news that might affect Nvidia's stock price, but it probably won't change your life. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
stories.simple_summary: A company called Nebius is planning to spend 40 billion dollars building AI computer centers. They plan to raise this money from customers paying upfront and from banks lending them money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in the tech industry. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights
stories.simple_summary: United Airlines turned off the ability for AI systems to book flights on its website. The airline decided to stop letting AI agents make purchases directly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you book flights through an AI assistant, you'll now have to complete the booking yourself instead of letting the AI do it all. This change makes things slightly less convenient but perhaps more secure.

stories.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
stories.simple_summary: News reports say Jensen Huang, the head of Nvidia, was involved in a third affair with an employee. He has already stepped down from his position at the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company scandal news that mostly affects Nvidia's reputation and employees there. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: No, AI agents did not discover a previously unknown Maya site
stories.simple_summary: A Google researcher claimed AI agents helped him discover an ancient Maya site in Mexico that nobody knew about. The claim turned out to be false because the site was already discovered and published in an academic paper a year earlier.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that even smart AI systems can make mistakes and spread wrong information if they're not checked carefully. Always check important facts from multiple sources, even when AI systems say something.
